intent: Inspect and refactor TelemetryIngestionService without changing its ast_hints API: verify layering (domain types only in ports, no blocking calls, no hardcoded config values), reactive lifecycle/backpressure, and that tests stay green. Unit: Context Telemetry Stream Intake. @Service, non-blocking, no blocking I/O. Constructor(SensorMetricBoundaryProvider, TelemetryEventBus, ReorderWindow, TelemetryProperties, Clock). ingest: for each sample of packet.toSamples() in order: validate via boundary (VALIDATION_FAILED tagged, never dropped), publish TelemetrySampleValidated or TelemetrySampleValidationFailed, offer to ReorderWindow; if outOfOrder publish TelemetryBackfillReordered; if late publish TelemetryBackfillReordered only when latePacketPolicy is APPEND_REVISION. Emits the number of samples processed; publish errors (overflow) propagate. flushReleasable: drains ReorderWindow.drainReleasable(clock.instant()) and, if non-empty, publishes TelemetryWindowBuffered(samples, first t_device, last t_device, now); empty otherwise. Never reads Ledger.
